column3: “The one tempting” becomes “the tempter,” and “speak” becomes “command”; “loaves” is rendered “bread.”
Close to the Greek; “declaration” (word) is rendered “word,” and the quotation is in capitals.

NASB has “Go, Satan!” without “behind me,” like the critical text.
